_comment: ATTACK_REACTION targeting an Assassin/Mystic attack action card. MODIFY_ATTACK +1{p} on the targeted attack (the current attack). LOOK_AT top 3 of defending hero's deck (player DEFENDING maps to defender). SELECT_FROM_REF chooses 1 card. CONDITIONAL_EFFECT checks if chosen card is blue (pitch 3) - if so, ADD_DEFEND with defense 0 (sets base_defense=0 per effect_types.py:2780-2781); else ADD_DEFEND with printed defense. REORDER_REF puts the rest on top of defending hero's deck in any order. ADD_DEFEND target uses a ref spec to add the chosen card (not the source).
